messages:
sam_k: quick heads-up — onboarding sampleapp is failing in json-mode when a tool returns a top-level array. JS SDK helper throws a schema validation error.
maria: can you paste the raw output + schema?
sam_k: minimal repro: ```json
[ {
  "id": 1,
  "text": "ok"
} ]
```
registered schema is an object (id:int, text:string).
maria: aha — schema expects object but got array. didn't we have an auto-unpack helper?
alex: parity bug. Python helper used to accept single-element arrays and coerce to the object; JS helper is stricter and fails. that's why python samples seemed fine.
jin: another wrinkle: our retry middleware sometimes stringifies the result on recovery (leftover debug change). that means validator sees a string like `"[... ]"`. so two issues: array vs object + stringified-json.
sam_k: yep. i found a stray `return JSON.stringify(result)` in the retry branch.
maria: mitigation options: 1) loosen sampleapp schema to accept both array/object, 2) make JS helper mirror Python coercion, 3) remove stringify in retry middleware.
alex: do (3) + (2) properly. (1) is a band-aid. i'll draft a small helper `normalizeFnOutput(raw, schema)` that: if typeof raw === 'string' try JSON.parse; if Array.isArray(v) and schema.type === 'object' and v.length === 1 then v = v[0]; return v. also emit a telemetry event when coercion occurs.
jin: agree — and add a unit test to simulate: a) tool returns array, b) retry returns stringified-array, c) normalize makes validation pass.
ci-bot: created issue #3498: "devex: js sdk helper normalize fncall array vs object + remove stringify on retry" (opened by alex)
sam_k: i'll patch sampleapp locally to accept array/stringified-array until helper lands. maria: can you add the tests?
maria: on it — adding tests in samplekit/tests/json_mode_coercion.test.ts and will run e2e with `--json-mode` to check parity with python sample.
alex: opening PR behind a feature flag `helpers.normalizeFncall=true` so we don't change public semantics without opt-in. will include changelog and migration note.
sam_k: thanks all. leaving thread open until PR merges + tests pass.
ci-bot: pipeline queued for branch alex/normalize-fncall -> build 8199 started
